posts.title: I'm not ok, are you?
posts.description: Today is World Mental Health day. I’m not ok, but more importantly are you ok? Please check in on yourself, friends and family. Now is as good a time as ever to say hi and ask “How’re you doing?” (Joey accent optional). I’m really struggling with my mental health at the moment, I’ve been masking constantly for a few months now and the cracks are showing. This week has especially been hard: I’ve been ill constantly for a while with a hernia that is pushing the opening of my stomach open causing acid to constantly escape. This is causing my body to create mucus in order to protect itself which in turn is causing me to cough a lot. I’m waiting for consulatation at the moment which will ultimately lead to surgery to fix the hernia. On Monday night someone through a brick through our neighbours window, I was cooking tea when I heard the smash and saw people running away. It’s shaking up the whole street. posts.title: My worst holidays of all time
posts.description: After chatting with my wife about the holidays we’ve been on I figured I’d write up some of our less fortunate ones. St Ives # I’ve spent so much time in St Ives, most of our summer holidays were spent there. I love it there but sadly it’s become far to expensive and isn’t the easiest to get to if you don’t drive. This particular holiday was rough. We went out for an evening meal to a seafood place, we’d been there enough times already and loved it. This particular time I knew the instance I’d swallowed the mussel that it was bad, I swallowed with the knowledge that this probably wasn’t going to end well. Fast forward to the next day and we have tacos for lunch, about an hour later my stomach starts to hurt and I’m burping mexican food. I start feeling worse and head back to the B&B where things get progressively worse. I’ll spare you the details of the next few days but it was hell confined to either the bathroom or bed. posts.title: Homelab Update July 2026
posts.description: I’ve decommissioned my remotelab.uk Mastodon server in favour of social.lol, I really like what they’re doing over there and had a similar idea for what I’d like remotelab to be. You can find me at mikebell@social.lol . There’s a new holding site up at https://remotelab.uk now. I finally got around to fixing my ForgeJo runners, it turns out it was never broken but the dflook tofu actions weren’t playing nice. I decided to move away from them and move to more native ways of doing it. As an added bonus I even added in comments which are a work in progress. I have a working repo here if your interested in how I manage OpenTofu in ForgeJo. Next job is to move the runners to a new server, renovate currently looks to have a memory leak in my specific setup - when I profiled the memory usage you could see it happily ticking along until it starts eating up as much as possible and getting killed.
